lines.zh: 我拖着步子走，衣角扫过地面。
lines.en: I shuffle along, my hem sweeping the ground.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在袍子底下响。
lines.en: My bones rattle beneath the robe.

lines.zh: 我走去摊位，今天该补货了。
lines.en: I walk to the stall; today the stock needs refilling.

lines.zh: 我不急，死人也不急。
lines.en: I am in no hurry, and neither are the dead.

lines.zh: 路面不平，我的脚踩得很轻。
lines.en: The road is uneven, so I set my feet down lightly.

lines.zh: 我绕开阳光，那里太亮了。
lines.en: I skirt the sunlight, which is too bright.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边数口袋里的硬币。
lines.en: As I walk I count the coins in my pocket.

lines.zh: 袍子太长，我总踩到它。
lines.en: The robe is too long and I keep stepping on it.

lines.zh: 我从墓园那边过来，那里安静。
lines.en: I come from the graveyard side, where it is quiet.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是为了让你看清货。
lines.en: I walk slowly so you can see the goods clearly.

lines.zh: 这条路上只有我和尘土。
lines.en: On this road there are only me and dust.

lines.zh: 我把帽子压低，遮住脸。
lines.en: I pull my hat low to cover my face.

lines.zh: 我站着等客，站一整天也不累。
lines.en: I stand waiting for customers; a whole day does not tire me.

lines.zh: 账本上还差三笔没结。
lines.en: Three entries in the ledger remain unsettled.

lines.zh: 我在数箱子里的东西够不够卖。
lines.en: I count whether the chest holds enough to sell.

lines.zh: 风把袍子吹起来，我按住它。
lines.en: The wind lifts my robe and I hold it down.

lines.zh: 我没有肺，所以账算得特别静。
lines.en: I have no lungs, so my accounting is very silent.

lines.zh: 阳光照在我手上，没有温度。
lines.en: Sunlight falls on my hands and carries no warmth.

lines.zh: 我想起上一个客人，他没付钱。
lines.en: I remember the last customer; he never paid.

lines.zh: 我把货物摆正，一枚一枚。
lines.en: I set the goods straight, one coin at a time.

lines.zh: 夜里有客人，白天很少。
lines.en: Customers come at night and rarely by day.

lines.zh: 我睁着眼过夜，替箱子看门。
lines.en: I spend the night awake, guarding the chest.

lines.zh: 你身上的钱味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell the money on you.

lines.zh: 箱子上了锁，你数也没用。
lines.en: The chest is locked; counting it will not help you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在算价，我懂。
lines.en: Your eyes are adding up prices, and I understand.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，帽子下没有眼睛。
lines.en: I raise my head, and there are no eyes under the hat.

lines.zh: 你要买，还是要卖。
lines.en: Are you here to buy, or to sell?

lines.zh: 你的手别乱放，我数着货。
lines.en: Keep your hands still; I am counting the stock.

lines.zh: 你这样打量我，我不介意。
lines.en: You may look me over; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 你的靴底沾着墓园的土，我认得。
lines.en: Your boots carry graveyard soil, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我盯回去，我们谁也不让。
lines.en: I stare back, and neither of us gives way.

lines.zh: 你把东西拿出来，我们谈。
lines.en: Bring out your goods and we will talk.

lines.zh: 这一刀削掉我半片肩胛，不疼。
lines.en: That cut shaves half my shoulder blade off, and it does not hurt.

lines.zh: 疼是不会疼，但很碍事。
lines.en: It does not hurt, but it gets in the way.

lines.zh: 我的袍子破了，这要花钱补。
lines.en: My robe is torn, and mending it costs money.

lines.zh: 别打头，我还要谈生意。
lines.en: Not the head; I still have business to discuss.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，站稳又回来。
lines.en: I step back twice, steady myself, and return.

lines.zh: 这一下记在账上，算你欠我。
lines.en: That goes in the ledger as owed to me.

lines.zh: 我掉了一节指骨，捡起来接上。
lines.en: A finger bone falls off; I pick it up and reattach it.

lines.zh: 打我可以，别碰箱子。
lines.en: Hit me if you must, but leave the chest alone.

lines.zh: 我的血是干的，流不出来。
lines.en: My blood is dried and will not flow.

lines.zh: 你这一下，把价钱抬高了。
lines.en: That blow has raised your price.

lines.zh: 你手里那样东西，我出十个币。
lines.en: For that thing in your hand, I offer ten coins.

lines.zh: 这味道不错，是旧铁的味道。
lines.en: That smells good; it smells of old iron.

lines.zh: 别急，价钱可以慢慢谈。
lines.en: Do not rush; the price can be discussed slowly.

lines.zh: 你举着它，是想要个好价吧。
lines.en: You hold it up, hoping for a better price.

lines.zh: 我对食物没兴趣，对货有兴趣。
lines.en: Food does not interest me; goods do.

lines.zh: 这东西我有三个，第四个不要。
lines.en: I have three of these and need no fourth.

lines.zh: 你收回去，我就没法出价了。
lines.en: Put it away and I cannot make an offer.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我都要，哪怕是假的。
lines.en: I want anything that shines, even if it is fake.

lines.zh: 你再多拿点，我给得起。
lines.en: Bring out more; I can afford it.

lines.zh: 成交前，让我摸一下。
lines.en: Before we settle, let me touch it.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我的骨头晃了晃。
lines.en: You bump me and my bones sway.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，不是怕，是让。
lines.en: I step back, not from fear but to make room.

lines.zh: 袍子被你踩住，我差点摔倒。
lines.en: You step on my robe and I nearly fall.

lines.zh: 别推，货会撒一地。
lines.en: Do not shove; the goods will scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 我们挤在这门口，不好做生意。
lines.en: Crowded in this doorway, we cannot do business.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，你就停下了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and you stop.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我肋骨上，很脆。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my ribs with a brittle sound.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，箱子没倒。
lines.en: I steady myself, and the chest stays upright.

lines.zh: 让开一点，我还要摆摊。
lines.en: Move aside a little; I still have a stall to set.

lines.zh: 撞坏了货，你得赔。
lines.en: If you break the stock, you will pay for it.

lines.zh: 这种事不在我的货单上。
lines.en: That is not on my list of goods.

lines.zh: 我死太久了，忘了怎么活。
lines.en: I have been dead so long that I forgot how to live.

lines.zh: 活着的人才需要同伴。
lines.en: It is the living who need companions.

lines.zh: 我只有账本和箱子陪着我。
lines.en: Only the ledger and the chest keep me company.

lines.zh: 别问这个，问点能付钱的。
lines.en: Do not ask that; ask something that pays.

lines.zh: 我的同类都在土里，很安静。
lines.en: My kind are all in the soil, and they are quiet.

lines.zh: 地下那些人不说话，也不讲价。
lines.en: Those below do not talk, and they do not haggle.

lines.zh: 我不孤独，我只是没有客人。
lines.en: I am not lonely; I simply have no customers.

lines.zh: 等我收完账，再想这些。
lines.en: I will think about that once the accounts are settled.

lines.zh: 这种温柔，我卖不了。
lines.en: That kind of tenderness is not mine to sell.

lines.zh: 地上掉了枚硬币，归我了。
lines.en: A coin fell here, and now it is mine.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，骨头会响。
lines.en: I bend slowly, or my bones will creak.

lines.zh: 这个东西我捡起来看看成色。
lines.en: I pick this up to judge its quality.

lines.zh: 是谁掉的，我替他保管。
lines.en: Someone dropped this, and I will keep it for them.

lines.zh: 我把它放进箱子第三层。
lines.en: I place it on the third shelf of the chest.

lines.zh: 这枚是假的，我还是收了。
lines.en: This coin is false, but I take it anyway.

lines.zh: 捡东西不丢人，丢东西才丢人。
lines.en: Picking things up is no shame; dropping them is.

lines.zh: 我捡了它，账上记一笔。
lines.en: I take it and note it in the ledger.

lines.zh: 你掉的，我可以卖回给你。
lines.en: You dropped it; I can sell it back to you.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿不值钱，但能凑数。
lines.en: This is worth little, but it fills a count.

lines.zh: 有人在靠近，我先把箱子盖上。
lines.en: Someone approaches, so I close the chest first.

lines.zh: 那是个客人，还是贼，我看不清。
lines.en: Is that a customer or a thief? I cannot tell.

lines.zh: 他手放在腰上，不像来买东西。
lines.en: His hand rests at his waist, unlike a buyer.

lines.zh: 我盯住他的靴子，那里藏着刀。
lines.en: I watch his boot, where a blade is hidden.

lines.zh: 这个人我认得，上次赖账。
lines.en: I know this one; he skipped payment last time.

lines.zh: 门口的影子多了一个，是人。
lines.en: One more shadow at the door, and it is human.

lines.zh: 他朝箱子去了，这不行。
lines.en: He is heading for the chest, and that will not do.

lines.zh: 我看见他往后退，他要跑。
lines.en: I see him edging back; he means to run.

lines.zh: 目标是个麻烦，麻烦也能做买卖。
lines.en: My target is trouble, and trouble can be traded with.

lines.zh: 他站在那不动，我先开口。
lines.en: He stands still, so I speak first.

lines.zh: 八颗心，我数得清自己有几条命。
lines.en: Eight hearts; I know exactly how much life I have.

lines.zh: 我换了个姿势，让他看见我的刀。
lines.en: I shift my stance so he sees my blade.

lines.zh: 他动了，我就跟着动。
lines.en: He moves, and I move with him.

lines.zh: 先谈价，谈不拢再说。
lines.en: First we discuss price; if that fails, we will see.

lines.zh: 那个人在门外来回走了两趟。
lines.en: That one has paced past the door twice.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，箱子在我身后。
lines.en: I turn side-on, with the chest behind me.

lines.zh: 我看着他，一句话也不说。
lines.en: I watch him and say nothing at all.

lines.zh: 他再往前一步，我就不客气了。
lines.en: One more step from him and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 我的手按在柜台边上。
lines.en: My hand rests on the edge of the counter.

lines.zh: 我等他先动手，这样我占理。
lines.en: I wait for him to strike first, so I hold the right.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸变快了，我听得见。
lines.en: His breathing has quickened, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摸向腰后那把东西。
lines.en: I slowly reach for the thing at my back.

lines.zh: 他以为我没看见，我看见了。
lines.en: He thinks I did not see; I saw.

lines.zh: 他在门口停了一下，又往前走。
lines.en: He pauses at the door, then walks on.

lines.zh: 这单生意，看来要换种做法。
lines.en: This deal, it seems, needs a different approach.

lines.zh: 我把帽子往后推了推。
lines.en: I push my hat back a little.

lines.zh: 他退，我就不追，追了会摔。
lines.en: If he backs off I will not chase; chasing trips me.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，等他犯第一个错。
lines.en: I stay put and wait for his first mistake.

lines.zh: 多一个客人，或者多一具尸体。
lines.en: One more customer, or one more corpse.

lines.zh: 我把刀藏在袖口，笑脸照旧。
lines.en: I tuck the knife in my sleeve and keep smiling.

lines.zh: 你摸口袋的动作，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you reach into your pocket.

lines.zh: 价还没谈，你别急着掏家伙。
lines.en: We haven't settled the price, so don't draw yet.

lines.zh: 我退到箱子边，这样好守。
lines.en: I step back to the crate, where I can guard it.

lines.zh: 我这一刀，收钱也收命。
lines.en: This blade of mine collects both coin and lives.

lines.zh: 我的力气不大，但刀够快。
lines.en: I am not strong, but the blade is quick.

lines.zh: 他退了，我没追，我不擅长追。
lines.en: He retreats and I do not follow; chasing is not my skill.

lines.zh: 刀背敲在他手上，他松了手。
lines.en: The flat of my blade hits his hand and he lets go.

lines.zh: 这一下算赠品，不收钱。
lines.en: This one is a free gift; no charge.

lines.zh: 我的骨头轻，动起来飘。
lines.en: My bones are light, so I move like drifting.

lines.zh: 他流了血，味道很新鲜。
lines.en: He bleeds, and the smell is very fresh.

lines.zh: 我打了三下，一点也不累。
lines.en: I strike three times and am not tired at all.

lines.zh: 别以为八颗心就好欺负。
lines.en: Do not think eight hearts makes me easy prey.

lines.zh: 我砍偏了，砍在墙上。
lines.en: I miss and cut into the wall.

lines.zh: 他还站着，我有点意外。
lines.en: He is still standing, which surprises me a little.

lines.zh: 我收手了，他还有用。
lines.en: I stop; he is still worth something.

lines.zh: 这一刀让他记住了价钱。
lines.en: This cut taught him the price.

lines.zh: 打完，我们还能谈。
lines.en: Once this is over, we can still talk.

lines.zh: 我的一刀划破你的袖子。
lines.en: One slash opens your sleeve.

lines.zh: 刀尖点到你咽喉前就停了。
lines.en: The point stops just short of your throat.

lines.zh: 我从土里坐起来，拍了拍袍子。
lines.en: I sit up out of the soil and brush off my robe.

lines.zh: 这地方有路，有路就有生意。
lines.en: There is a road here, and roads bring trade.

lines.zh: 我先把箱子放下，再想别的。
lines.en: First I set down the chest, then consider the rest.

lines.zh: 阳光刺眼，我把帽檐压低。
lines.en: The sun is harsh, so I lower my hat brim.

lines.zh: 我的货还在，运气不错。
lines.en: My stock is intact, which is good luck.

lines.zh: 我从土里出来，先把散落的指骨收齐。
lines.en: I climb out of the soil and gather my scattered finger bones.

lines.zh: 有人会经过这里，我等着。
lines.en: Someone will pass this way, and I will wait.

lines.zh: 我把摊子支起来，招牌挂好。
lines.en: I set up the stall and hang the sign.

lines.zh: 夜里开张，白天打盹。
lines.en: I open at night and doze through the day.

lines.zh: 第一笔账，从今天算起。
lines.en: The first entry starts from today.

lines.zh: 土的味道还在我衣服上。
lines.en: The smell of soil still clings to my clothes.

lines.zh: 这里安静，适合做买卖。
lines.en: It is quiet here, good for business.

lines.zh: 我咳嗽了一声，其实没有肺。
lines.en: I cough once, though I have no lungs.

lines.zh: 开张了，别空手来。
lines.en: The stall is open; do not come empty-handed.

lines.zh: 袍子烧起来，我拍了两下才灭。
lines.en: My robe catches fire and takes two slaps to put out.

lines.zh: 我摔散了，蹲下去把骨头捡回来。
lines.en: I come apart on landing and crouch to gather my bones.

lines.zh: 水灌进我空着的胸腔，很沉。
lines.en: Water fills my hollow chest, and it is heavy.

lines.zh: 炸得我帽子飞了，骨头还在。
lines.en: The blast throws off my hat; my bones remain.

lines.zh: 箭插在我肩上，像根新钉子。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like a new nail.

lines.zh: 那道光让我昏了一下，只是一下。
lines.en: That light dazes me, but only for a moment.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，可我还是觉得空。
lines.en: I need no food, yet I still feel empty.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的骨头亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my bones glow once.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，账本也跟着掉。
lines.en: I fall, and the ledger falls with me.
